meta.name: ab-test-setup
meta.description: When the user wants to plan, design, or implement an A/B test or experiment. Also use when the user mentions "A/B test," "split test," "experiment," "test this change," "variant copy," "multivariate test," "hypothesis," "conversion experiment," "statistical significance," or "test this." For tracking implementation, see analytics-tracking.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 规划并实施A/B测试以优化转化率
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要验证产品改动对用户行为的影响
copy.tagline_en: Plan and implement A/B tests to optimize conversion
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to validate the impact of product changes on user behavior

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会帮你设计 A/B 测试，包括提出假设、计算样本量、选择指标、设计变体，并生成实验文档。
howto.when: 当你提到“A/B测试”、“实验”、“假设”、“转化率”等关键词，或要求测试某个改动时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个A/B测试，测试按钮颜色对点击率的影响。
say.note: Claude 会引导你完成假设、样本量计算等步骤。

say.text: 我的着陆页转化率是5%，想提升到6%，该怎么做测试？
say.note: Claude 会建议测试方案并计算所需样本量。

say.text: 对比两个标题文案，哪个转化率更高？
say.note: Claude 会帮你设计一个A/B测试来验证。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude helps you design A/B tests, including formulating hypotheses, calculating sample sizes, selecting metrics, designing variants, and generating experiment documentation.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "A/B test", "experiment", "hypothesis", "conversion rate", or ask to test a change.

say_en.text: Help me design an A/B test to see if button color affects click-through rate.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you through hypothesis, sample size, etc.

say_en.text: My landing page conversion rate is 5%, I want to increase it to 6%. How should I test?
say_en.note: Claude will suggest a test plan and calculate sample size.

say_en.text: Compare two headline copies to see which converts better.
say_en.note: Claude will help you set up an A/B test to find out.
